name: get_api_reference
description: Search the UI5 API reference for module names and symbols

projectDir.description: The root directory of the UI5 project, containing the 'package.json' and 'ui5.yaml' files. This is used to determine the UI5 framework version and libraries used in the project.

query.description: Name of the UI5 module or symbol using either dot or slash notation. Examples: 'sap.m.Button', 'sap/ui/core/Core'. Individual symbols can be requested as well, e.g. 'sap.m.Button#text', 'sap.ui.core.Core#init'
